title: Horseshoe Bend and Antelope Canyon Day Tour from Phoenix
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Discover the stunning landscapes of Horseshoe Bend and Antelope Canyon on this unforgettable day tour. Starting from Einstein Bros. Bagels in Phoenix, journey through Flagstaff before arriving in Page, Arizona. Enjoy a delicious lunch at a local restaurant before taking a scenic hike to Horseshoe Bend, known for its breathtaking views. Afterward, explore the sacred Antelope Canyon, accessible only with Navajo guides, where nature's artistry is on full display. This tour is perfect for nature enthusiasts and those interested in Native American culture, led by a knowledgeable local guide who knows all the hidden gems.

- Full-day tour from Phoenix to Horseshoe Bend and Antelope Canyon
- Scenic drive through Flagstaff with beautiful views
- Local lunch at a highly-rated cafe
- Expert Navajo guides for a unique cultural experience at Antelope Canyon
